F_Fleet.name: Fleet / Reach and Resolve
F_Fleet.description: Core-aligned military and relief fleet operating heavy cruisers, escorts, memorial doctrine, and corridor protection.
F_Fleet.politicalNotes: Balances protection, projection doctrine, remembrance, and increasing pressure to cooperate across faction lines.

F_Verge.name: The Verge
F_Verge.description: Frontier trade worlds, farms, freeports, escorts, and civilian governments dependent on functioning corridors.
F_Verge.politicalNotes: Demands practical autonomy, reliable trade, food, and dignity rather than dependence on Core protection.

F_Shards.name: The Shards / Confederacy
F_Shards.description: Shard settlements, salvagers, raiders, warlords, and survival blocs formed in the debris and scarcity after the Shattering.
F_Shards.politicalNotes: Internally divided between survival pragmatists, crown-seekers, raiders, and the Silent Triarch.

F_Trade.name: Independent Trade / Veil Market
F_Trade.description: Brokers, smugglers, merchants, and information traders operating between formal factions.
F_Trade.politicalNotes: Transactional neutrality becomes harder to sustain as famine and corridor instability turn information into survival.

F_Lattice.name: Lattice Research / Corridor Exploration
F_Lattice.description: Scientists, survey crews, and anomaly observers working around reciprocal-field and corridor phenomena.
F_Lattice.politicalNotes: Technical cooperation crosses political boundaries because corridor physics does not respect factional borders.
